snippet.title: Laser Matrix Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on the Meta Quest Store: https://vr.meta.me/s/2awFbZaqJ8aVKtN

Dodge laser-like hazards, activate glowing buttons, and navigate your own room as it transforms into a dynamic puzzle arena.

Laser Matrix is a Mixed Reality action-puzzle game where reflexes, spatial awareness, and quick thinking collide. Whether you’re chasing leaderboard glory or just getting in a fun workout, each level amps up the intensity with new mechanics, patterns, and MR trickery.

Built from the ground up for mixed reality, Laser Matrix delivers a physical, high-energy experience with fitness, fun, and future-tech all rolled into one.

#vr #vrgames #quest3
